title: Lamborghini Huracan Performante & Helicopter
text: This experience was one of the coolest things we did while in Barcelona!  Friendly and professional staff, awesome cars and a fun little drive around town in a brand new Huracan.  The Helicopter ride was exhilarating and well worth the money.  This is a must do if visiting the area.  I cannot say enough about how great the staff at both Driveme and CAT Helicopters were.  The booking was easily done through the Driveme website and the communication for when and where to be was very clear.  Both experiences were on time to the T !  Thanks Driveme for an absolutely wonderful experience.
author: bkimball2019
